sentences.en: At any rate, if you learn English, study it thoroughly.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，如果你学英语，就要彻底地学习。

sentences.en: When I reached the summit, I was thoroughly worn out.
sentences.zh: 当我到达山顶时，我已经筋疲力尽了。

sentences.en: Yuriko thoroughly enjoyed her occasional secret meetings with her lover.
sentences.zh: 由里子非常享受她偶尔与情人秘密会面的时光。

senses.zh: 彻底地；认真仔细地完全地；非常，极其
